headlines.title: 央行：单一的贷款指标已不能完整反映实体经济获得的融资状况
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行货币政策司司长谢光启在国新办新闻发布会上表示，央行正在持续优化和完善货币政策的框架，推动货币政策框架从数量型调控为主向价格型调控为主转型，着力营造适宜的货币金融环境。现在单一的贷款指标已经不能完整反映实体经济获得的融资状况，建议大家可以将贷款和债券加在一起来观察，同时更多观察像利率、融资结构等这些全面反映社会融资条件的指标。（证券时报）

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Single loan indicator no longer fully reflects financing conditions of the real economy
headlines.summary_en: Xie Guangqi, Director of the PBOC's Monetary Policy Department, said at a State Council Information Office press conference that the central bank is continuously optimizing and improving its monetary policy framework, pushing for a transition from quantity-based to price-based regulation to create a suitable monetary and financial environment. He noted that single loan indicators can no longer fully reflect the financing conditions of the real economy, suggesting that loans and bonds should be viewed together, along with indicators such as interest rates and financing structure that comprehensively reflect social financing conditions. (Securities Times)

headlines.title: 央行：未来一段时期，贷款的降速提质可能成为宏观运行的新常态之一
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行货币政策司司长谢光启15日在国新办新闻发布会上表示，未来一段时期，货币信贷会从外延式的扩张转向内涵式的发展，贷款的降速提质可能成为宏观运行的新常态之一。（新华财经）

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Over the next period, slower loan growth and quality improvement may become a new normal in macro operations
headlines.summary_en: Xie Guangqi, Director of the PBOC's Monetary Policy Department, said at a State Council Information Office press conference on the 15th that in the coming period, monetary credit will shift from extensive expansion to intensive development, and slower loan growth with improved quality may become a new normal in macro operations. (Xinhua Finance)

headlines.title: 央行：截至6月末普惠小微贷款同比增长8.3%
headlines.summary: 7月15日，人民银行副行长邹澜在国新办新闻发布会上表示，截至6月末，普惠小微贷款同比增长8.3%，工业中长期贷款同比增长5.9%，不含房地产业的服务业中长期贷款余额同比增长9.2%，这几项都高于全部贷款增速。

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Inclusive small-micro loans grew 8.3% year-on-year as of end-June
headlines.summary_en: On July 15, PBOC Deputy Governor Zou Lan said at a State Council Information Office press conference that as of the end of June, inclusive small and micro loans grew 8.3% year-on-year, medium- and long-term industrial loans grew 5.9%, and medium- and long-term loans to the service sector excluding real estate grew 9.2%, all exceeding overall loan growth.

headlines.title: 央行：继续常态化发行央行票据，支持财政部提高离岸人民币国债发行规模

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Continue regular issuance of central bank bills, support MOF in increasing offshore RMB government bond issuance scale
headlines.summary_en: PBOC: Continue the routine issuance of central bank bills and support the Ministry of Finance in increasing the scale of offshore renminbi government bond issuances. (Securities Times)

headlines.title: 央行：将根据经济运行、物价走势和宏观调控需要，引导调控好利率水平
headlines.summary: 7月15日，中国人民银行副行长邹澜在国新办新闻发布会上表示，利率方面，后续人民银行将根据宏观经济运行情况、物价走势和宏观调控的需要，引导调控好利率水平，促进社会综合融资成本低位运行。

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Guide and regulate interest rate levels based on economic performance, price trends, and macro-control needs
headlines.summary_en: On July 15, PBOC Deputy Governor Zou Lan said at a State Council Information Office press conference that regarding interest rates, the central bank will guide and regulate interest rate levels based on macroeconomic conditions, price trends, and macro-control needs, promoting low comprehensive social financing costs.

headlines.title: 央行：人民币汇率预计会继续双向波动
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行新闻发言人、副行长邹澜15日在国新办新闻发布会上表示，向前看，影响人民币汇率的因素较为多元，推动升值和贬值的因素都有，人民币汇率预计会继续双向波动。（新华财经）

headlines.title_en: PBOC: RMB exchange rate expected to continue two-way fluctuations
headlines.summary_en: PBOC spokesperson and Deputy Governor Zou Lan said at a State Council Information Office press conference on the 15th that looking ahead, factors influencing the renminbi exchange rate are diverse, with both appreciation and depreciation pressures, and the renminbi exchange rate is expected to continue two-way fluctuations. (Xinhua Finance)

headlines.title: 央行：研究逐步增加隔夜逆回购的操作频率
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行新闻发言人、副行长邹澜15日在国新办新闻发布会上表示，下一步，人民银行将继续平稳有序推动货币政策操作框架的改革完善，更好引导市场隔夜利率在政策利率附近平稳运行；结合一级交易商需求，研究逐步增加隔夜逆回购的操作频率，并和市场做好沟通。（新华财经）

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Studying gradual increase in frequency of overnight reverse repo operations
headlines.summary_en: PBOC spokesperson and Deputy Governor Zou Lan said at a State Council Information Office press conference on the 15th that next, the central bank will smoothly and orderly promote reform and improvement of the monetary policy operational framework, better guide overnight market rates to run steadily near the policy rate, and study gradually increasing the frequency of overnight reverse repo operations based on primary dealer demand, while communicating with the market. (Xinhua Finance)

headlines.title: 央行：不宜根据单次公开市场操作量多少判断央行政策取向
headlines.summary: 7月15日，人民银行副行长邹澜在国新办新闻发布会上表示，人民银行会统筹考虑多种因素变化，合理安排公开市场操作的品种和规模，有时回笼，有时投放，最终是保持流动性总量处于合适水平，从而促进短端利率在政策利率附近平稳运行。某一次的操作量多少是服务于流动性总量调控的需要，不宜根据单次操作量的多少来判断央行的政策取向。相对于央行的操作量，短端市场利率水平是一个更适宜的观测指标。（证券时报）

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Do not judge policy stance based on single open market operation amount
headlines.summary_en: On July 15, PBOC Deputy Governor Zou Lan said at a State Council Information Office press conference that the central bank will consider multiple factors, reasonably arrange the variety and scale of open market operations, sometimes draining and sometimes injecting, ultimately keeping total liquidity at an appropriate level to promote short-term rates running steadily near the policy rate. The scale of a single operation serves the need for aggregate liquidity control and should not be used to judge the central bank's policy stance. Short-term market rates are a more suitable observation indicator than the central bank's operation scale. (Securities Times)

headlines.title: 央行：加大逆周期和跨周期调节力度 巩固拓展经济稳中向好势头
headlines.summary: 7月15日，人民银行副行长邹澜在国新办新闻发布会上表示，央行将根据国内外经济金融形势和金融市场运行情况，把握好货币政策实施的力度、节奏和时机，加大逆周期和跨周期调节力度，着力扩大内需、优化供给，增强经济发展内生动力，不断巩固拓展经济稳中向好的势头。

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Intensify counter-cyclical and cross-cyclical adjustments to consolidate and extend economic stability and improvement
headlines.summary_en: On July 15, PBOC Deputy Governor Zou Lan said at a State Council Information Office press conference that the central bank will, based on domestic and international economic and financial conditions and financial market operations, grasp the intensity, pace, and timing of monetary policy implementation, increase counter-cyclical and cross-cyclical adjustments, focus on expanding domestic demand, optimizing supply, strengthening the economy's endogenous growth momentum, and continuously consolidating and expanding the economy's positive momentum.

headlines.title: 央行：1—6月新发放企业贷款加权平均利率大约为3%
headlines.summary: 7月15日，人民银行副行长邹澜在国新办新闻发布会上表示，1—6月，新发放企业贷款加权平均利率大约为3%，比上年同期低约20个基点；新发放的个人住房贷款利率约3.1%，与上年同期基本持平。

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Weighted average interest rate on new corporate loans in Jan-Jun was around 3%
headlines.summary_en: On July 15, PBOC Deputy Governor Zou Lan said at a State Council Information Office press conference that from January to June, the weighted average interest rate on new corporate loans was about 3%, down about 20 basis points year-on-year, and the new personal housing loan rate was about 3.1%, roughly flat year-on-year.

headlines.title: 中国央行：上半年人民币存款增加17.76万亿元
headlines.summary: 中国央行：6月末，本外币存款余额354.33万亿元，同比增长8.2%。月末人民币存款余额346.44万亿元，同比增长8.2%。 上半年人民币存款增加17.76万亿元。其中，住户存款增加7.58万亿元，非金融企业存款增加3.2万亿元，财政性存款增加9715亿元，非银行业金融机构存款增加4.65万亿元。 6月末，外币存款余额1.16万亿美元，同比增长13.7%。上半年外币存款增加980亿美元。

headlines.title_en: PBoC: RMB deposits increased by 17.76 trillion yuan in H1
headlines.summary_en: PBOC: At the end of June, total deposits in domestic and foreign currency stood at 354.33 trillion yuan, up 8.2% year-on-year. Renminbi deposits at the end of the month were 346.44 trillion yuan, up 8.2% year-on-year. In the first half of the year, renminbi deposits increased by 17.76 trillion yuan, including 7.58 trillion yuan from households, 3.2 trillion yuan from non-financial enterprises, 971.5 billion yuan from fiscal deposits, and 4.65 trillion yuan from non-bank financial institutions. At the end of June, foreign currency deposits stood at $1.16 trillion, up 13.7% year-on-year. In the first half of the year, foreign currency deposits increased by $98 billion.

headlines.title: 东方金诚王青：全年经济将呈现“V型”走势
headlines.summary: 据国家统计局最新数据，东方金诚首席经济学家王青表示，稳增长政策适度发力带动内需回升，以及短期影响因素消退等带动下，三季度GDP增速将回升至4.6%左右，四季度有望进一步加快，全年经济将呈现“V型”走势。其中，下半年以高技术制造业为代表的新动能还会保持较快发展势头，而以房地产为代表的老动能会继续承压，经济“K型”分化格局也会延续。（证券时报）

headlines.title_en: Golden Credit Rating Wang Qing: Full-year economy to show 'V-shaped' trend
headlines.summary_en: According to the latest National Bureau of Statistics data, Dongfang Jincheng Chief Economist Wang Qing said that driven by moderate pro-growth policies boosting domestic demand and the fading of short-term factors, Q3 GDP growth is expected to rebound to around 4.6%, with further acceleration in Q4, forming a 'V-shaped' trend for the full year. In the second half, new drivers like high-tech manufacturing will maintain rapid development, while old drivers like real estate will continue to face pressure, extending the 'K-shaped' divergence pattern. (Securities Times)

headlines.title: 央行：继续推动熊猫债市场发展 便利境外机构参与境内熊猫债发行和交易
headlines.summary: 7月15日，中国人民银行副行长邹澜在国新办新闻发布会上表示，近年来，人民币在跨境贸易投融资等领域使用更加广泛，境外主体对人民币的融资需求增强。2026年上半年，熊猫债券发行超过1600亿元，同比增长超60%。

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Continue to develop panda bond market, facilitate overseas institutions' participation in onshore panda bond issuance and trading
headlines.summary_en: On July 15, PBOC Deputy Governor Zou Lan said at a State Council Information Office press conference that in recent years, the renminbi has been more widely used in cross-border trade and investment, with increased foreign demand for renminbi financing. In the first half of 2026, panda bond issuance exceeded 160 billion yuan, up over 60% year-on-year.

headlines.title: 申万宏源赵伟：若后续内需复苏态势仍不稳固 财政与货币政策或协同发力
headlines.summary: 【申万宏源赵伟：若后续内需复苏态势仍不稳固 财政与货币政策或协同发力】日前，央行公布2026年6月中国金融数据，信贷余额同比增速下行0.3个百分点至5.2%，社融存量同比下行0.3个百分点至7.4%，M2同比下行0.6个百分点至8.0%。对此，申万宏源证券首席经济学家赵伟表示，货币政策或将根据国内外经济金融形势和金融市场运行情况，前瞻性、灵活性、针对性地开展流动性操作，在风险防控与稳增长之间实现动态平衡。
headlines.title_zh: 申万宏源赵伟：若后续内需复苏态势仍不稳固 财政与货币政策或协同发力
headlines.summary_zh: 【申万宏源赵伟：若后续内需复苏态势仍不稳固 财政与货币政策或协同发力】日前，央行公布2026年6月中国金融数据，信贷余额同比增速下行0.3个百分点至5.2%，社融存量同比下行0.3个百分点至7.4%，M2同比下行0.6个百分点至8.0%。对此，申万宏源证券首席经济学家赵伟表示，货币政策或将根据国内外经济金融形势和金融市场运行情况，前瞻性、灵活性、针对性地开展流动性操作，在风险防控与稳增长之间实现动态平衡。

headlines.title: 美对俄新制裁将俄油气的中印买家列为目标，外交部：只会搬起石头砸自己脚
headlines.summary: 7月15日，外交部发言人林剑主持例行记者会。据报道，美国14日公布了对俄罗斯制裁法案的更新版本，新版措施把包括中国和印度在内的俄罗斯原油和天然气五大买家列为制裁目标，授权特朗普对相关国家最高征收100%的关税。彭博社记者在会上就此事提问，中方对此有何回应？ 林剑强调，中方坚决反对没有国际法依据、未经联合国安理会授权的非法单边制裁，将采取一切必要措施，坚定维护本国企业和公民的正当权益。“搞双重标准，胁迫施压，最终只会搬起石头砸自己的脚。”林剑说。（澎湃新闻）

headlines.title_en: New US sanctions on Russia target Chinese and Indian buyers of Russian oil and gas; Foreign Ministry says this will only backfire
headlines.summary_en: On July 15, Foreign Ministry spokesman Lin Jian hosted a regular press conference. Reports said the US released an updated version of its Russia sanctions law on the 14th, with new measures targeting Russia's top five buyers of crude oil and natural gas including China and India, authorizing Trump to impose tariffs of up to 100% on relevant countries. A Bloomberg reporter asked for China's response. Lin Jian stressed China firmly opposes illegal unilateral sanctions without UN Security Council authorization, and will take all necessary measures to firmly protect the legitimate rights and interests of its firms and citizens. 'Double standards, coercion and pressure will only end up backfiring,' Lin Jian said. (The Paper)

headlines.summary: 中国人民银行新闻发言人、副行长邹澜在国新办新闻发布会上表示，上半年央行各项工具投放量有效对冲了缴纳存款准备金、现金投放等因素带来的1万亿流动性缺口，货币市场隔夜利率DR001前6个月均值为1.31%，总体运行平稳。

headlines.title_en: PBOC: H1 central bank tool injections effectively offset 1 trillion yuan liquidity gap from factors like reserve requirement deposits
headlines.summary_en: PBOC spokesperson and Deputy Governor Zou Lan said at a State Council Information Office press conference that in the first half of the year, the central bank's various tool injections effectively offset the 1 trillion yuan liquidity gap from factors like reserve requirement deposits and cash issuance, with the overnight interbank rate DR001 averaging 1.31% in the first six months, running steadily overall.

headlines.title: 欧洲央行管委帕内塔：欧洲央行决心保持通胀预期稳定
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月15日讯，欧洲央行管委会成员、意大利央行行长帕内塔周三表示，即便在地缘政治局势充满不确定性的背景下，欧洲央行的货币政策也必须保持审慎，以确保通胀预期保持稳定。 他称：“在考虑未来决策时，欧洲央行管理委员会将仔细评估能源市场状况，以及经济形势、工资水平和商品及服务价格的走势。我们的目标是牢牢锚定通胀预期，限制各类冲击带来的间接影响及第二轮效应。”

headlines.title_en: ECB Governing Council member Panetta: ECB determined to keep inflation expectations stable
headlines.summary_en: GOLDEN TEN DATA July 15 - European Central Bank Governing Council member and Bank of Italy Governor Panetta said Wednesday that even against a backdrop of geopolitical uncertainty, the ECB's monetary policy must remain prudent to ensure inflation expectations stay stable. He stated: 'When considering future decisions, the ECB Governing Council will carefully assess energy market conditions, as well as economic conditions, wage levels, and price trends for goods and services. Our goal is to firmly anchor inflation expectations and limit indirect effects and second-round effects from various shocks.'
